title_en: Revision and resumption of sales of 'Level-Premium Term Insurance with Disaster Coverage Period (Non-participating)'
summary_en: Sony Life announced on 30 October 2025 that it will revise its corporate term product "Level Term Insurance with Accident Coverage Period (non-participating)" and put it back on sale from 2 December 2025. The product was first launched in January 2019 and pulled the next month. The revision allows application with only three health questions and no medical exam, up to a maximum of 500 million yen. It also widens the range of contract ages (15–79) and coverage terms (to age 70–99) available. The product is aimed mainly at older business owners who have health concerns.

It replaces the 2015 yen and 2017 USD single-premium products. Four riders are available. summary_en: Sony Life Insurance announced on 30 April 2026 that it received a report-demand order from the Financial Services Agency under Article 128, Paragraph 1 of the Insurance Business Act. The order covers the company's handling of its misconduct cases and its ongoing check of customers' contract status. The company apologized and said it will work to eradicate misconduct. It plans to publish progress on the check around the end of May 2026 and to disclose updates after that, as stated in its 24 April 2026 release.

summary_en: Sony Life announced on 8 October 2026 that from 2 November 2026 it will revise its non-participating limited-pay whole life insurance and resume selling the single-premium version, which it halted in July 1998.
